content: Recently, many datasets have been proposed to build and evaluate reading models BIBREF0 , BIBREF1 . From cloze style questions BIBREF2 to open questions BIBREF3 , from synthetic data BIBREF4 to human written articles BIBREF5 , many styles of documents and questions have been proposed to challenge reading models. The correct answer to the questions proposed in most of these datasets is a span of text of the source document, which can be restricted to a single word in several cases. It means that the answer should explicitly be present in the source document and that the model should be able to locate it.
